# Legal DB - Claude Desktop extension

Install: double-click the .mcpb file (or Settings > Extensions > drag it in) and confirm.
First run: the USER runs the setup wizard once in a terminal (the extension tells Claude the exact command):
    powershell -NoProfile -File "<extension folder>\tools\Setup-MasTmd.ps1"
Tools: legal_read, legal_preview, legal_apply (preview first, apply only after explicit approval). Windows only. Unofficial.
